notes:
Summary:
- Enterprise helpdesk SaaS (~1.2k employees) building RAG-based agent + ticket deflection. Primary goal: cut live agent load by 30% while preserving answer precision for top-5 results.
- Tight latency SLOs — product team insists on P99 < 350ms for combined retrieval + lightweight neural rerank for top-5. Quote from SVP Eng: "Users must feel instant; anything >400ms shows in CSAT drop."

Recent timeline (bulletized CRM style):
- 2026-01-12: Intro call (Maya) — overview of Redwood and product fit. Customer baseline: Elastic + in-house reranker; scaling pain + cost concerns.
- 2026-01-25: Technical deep dive with Carlos (SE) — reviewed current index: 30M docs, per-doc avg length 1.2k tokens, existing vector store on Elastic + custom ANN. Discussed embedding model options (open-source vs hosted).
- 2026-02-03: Security questionnaire submitted; initial SOC2 + SSO requirements flagged.
- 2026-02-15: POC kickoff (4-week). Integrating Redwood Dedicated staging pool; ingest pipeline for incremental updates tested. Fireflies: ff_6472b2c1.
- 2026-03-05: Mid-POC check-in — retrieval p50 ~95ms, p99 ~430ms (above target); rerank adds ~80ms median on current setup. Need kernel/quantization tweaks + smarter batching.
- 2026-03-10: Perf deep dive w/infra team. Short-term levers: prefix caching on ticket threads, smaller quantized reranker for top-20 then cross-encoder for top-5. Carlos suggested caching hot queries (50% of traffic).

Use-case & requirements (engineer notes):
- Workloads: high QPS webchat + agent-assist backchannel. Bursty patterns with afternoon peaks.
- Indexing scale: starting 30M docs, expect 3–4x growth by EOY. Need efficient incremental indexing and delta-updates.
- Reranking: staged approach — ANN -> lightweight transformer rerank (fast) -> optional cross-encoder for final top-5 on 95% of queries. Requirement: top-5 precision >= 85% on labeled eval set.
- Latency targets: p50 end-to-end <120ms, p95 <250ms, p99 <350ms. Cost target < $0.002/query average including embedding calls.
- Model preferences: prefer open/model variants that can run on Dedicated GPUs (quantized), but open to hosted embeddings if cost-effective.
- Security/compliance: must support SSO (SAML), KMS-backed key management, audit logs retention 2y, EU data residency for EU customers.

POC metrics tracked (internal):
- Retrieval recall@10 baseline (in-house): 0.74. Goal w/embedding+rerank >=0.82.
- Rerank top-5 precision baseline: 0.63. Target: >=0.85.
- Cost baseline: $0.005/query. Target: <$0.002.
- Perf: currently p99 combined 510ms when cold; need engineering changes to meet 350ms SLO.
